STAGE 0b: BASE CANDLE DEFINITION & SWING VALIDITY GATE (EXPERT LAW)
MANDATORY GATE — NO POI CAN FORM ON AN INVALID SWING
• Bullish Trend Base Candle: The single candle whose HIGH is the swing high.
Not the candle before, not the candle after. Exactly the candle creating the extreme high.
• Bearish Trend Base Candle: The candle whose LOW is the swing low.
★ Bearish Exception: If bearish candle exists and next candle's wick makes a lower low,
the bearish candle is still the Base Candle (proves institutional selling intent).
CORE RULE: Did price break Base Candle's OPPOSITE extreme AND candle body close beyond it?
• Bullish: Candle body closes BELOW Base Candle LOW
• Bearish: Candle body closes ABOVE Base Candle HIGH
➔ Confirmed structural swing. POI generation unlocked.
• Wick only pierce without candle body close
• Price never reaches Base Candle extreme
➔ NO POI CAN FORM. Discard setup entirely.
"Some traders say a 2-bar reversal confirms a valid swing. That is an error."
• A 2-bar reversal pattern alone does NOT validate a swing point.
• Until the market breaks the Base Candle extreme with a full candle body close,
the swing remains unconfirmed, internal, and vulnerable to liquidity runs.
LOCKED LAW: Base Candle Extreme Break + Body Close is Non-Negotiable.
